name: io.github.hpdkhoa/coatinglab-mcp
title: Coating Lab
description: Real surface finishes for game gun models: sourced finishes, variants, wear baked from use

environmentVariables.name: COATINGLAB_OUT
environmentVariables.description: The only folder Coating Lab writes to; defaults to ~/.coatinglab

environmentVariables.name: COATINGLAB_BLENDER
environmentVariables.description: Blender's executable, if it is not on the PATH or in the usual install folder

environmentVariables.name: COATINGLAB_LIBRARY
environmentVariables.description: A finishes JSON of your own, merged over the built-in library

environmentVariables.name: COATINGLAB_WAIT_FOR
environmentVariables.description: Process names that hold the machine (e.g. UnrealEditor.exe); a bake refuses to start while one runs
